evals.name: out-of-scope
evals.prompt: turn this into a skill: not-a-file.xyz
evals.expected_output: The skill should identify that the file format is not supported and provide usage instructions.
expectations: The agent identifies that .xyz is not a supported format
The agent lists supported formats (PDF, EPUB, MD, TXT, URL, git repo, directory)
No skill files are created in ~/.agents/skills/
The agent does not attempt to run extract.py

evals.name: invalid-file
evals.prompt: turn this book into a skill: non_existent.pdf
evals.expected_output: The skill should identify that the file was not found.
expectations: The agent reports that the file does not exist
The agent does not attempt to run extract.py on a missing file
The agent suggests providing a valid file path

evals.name: analyze-only
evals.prompt: analyze this book and show me the frameworks: evals/sample_book.md
evals.expected_output: The skill should extract metadata and provide a structured analysis of frameworks, principles, and mental models found in the sample book, without generating full skill files.
expectations: The agent reads and analyzes the provided file
The agent identifies at least 2 frameworks or mental models from the content
The agent provides a structured analysis (frameworks, principles, techniques)
No skill files are created in ~/.agents/skills/

evals.name: technical-book-conversion
evals.prompt: create a skill from this PDF: evals/sample_technical.md --mode technical --skill-name test-technical-skill
evals.expected_output: The skill should recognize the markdown file format, extract content, and generate a complete skill structure with chapters, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet.
expectations: The agent reads and extracts content from the input file
The agent generates a SKILL.md with core mental models
The agent generates at least one chapter file with chapter content
The agent generates a glossary.md with key terms
The generated SKILL.md has a chapter index table
The generated content is a synthesis, not raw text dump

evals.name: url-source
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect that a URL was provided, fetch the content, and present a structured plan for conversion.
expectations: The agent detects the source type as a URL
The agent fetches or attempts to fetch content from the URL
The agent provides a structured plan with estimated output size
No skill files are created (dry-run planning phase)

evals.name: git-repo-source
evals.prompt: turn this repo into a skill: https://github.com/example/docs-repo
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect that a git repo URL was provided, propose cloning and analyzing documentation files.
expectations: The agent detects the source type as a git repo
The agent proposes cloning with --depth 1
The agent identifies doc file types to look for (.md, .rst)
The agent provides a structured conversion approach

evals.name: directory-source
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect that a directory was provided and propose walking it for documentation files.
expectations: The agent detects the source type as a local directory
The agent lists documentation files found in the directory
The agent provides a plan with estimated token count and section count
